title: Monorepo + CI scaffold (license-gate + provenance + not-for-clinical-use linters)
context: The project needs an agent-neutral monorepo skeleton with CI gates that enforce the three non-negotiable safety properties before any data pipeline exists: (1) license gate — no derived artifact may reference a source not approved in sources/allowlist.yml; (2) provenance completeness — every dataset/result record must carry all fields defined in pathology-image-benchmarks-prov-001; (3) 'not for clinical or diagnostic use' — every model card and dataset artifact must carry the notice. Python WSI tooling must be isolated as an adapter, not placed in the agent-neutral core. See PLAN.md (Solution approach & architecture) and TASKS.md (pathology-image-benchmarks-scaffold-001 acceptance criteria).
objective: Create the monorepo scaffold with pnpm workspaces (TypeScript/ESM for the Hee-Lee Oss-facing core; Python WSI tooling isolated as a documented adapter placeholder), and wire three CI linters: (1) a license-gate linter that fails if any dataset or result record references a source not marked approved in sources/allowlist.yml; (2) a provenance-completeness linter that fails on any record missing a required provenance field; (3) a not-for-clinical-use linter that fails if any model card or dataset artifact omits the mandatory notice. pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint must pass.
acceptanceCriteria: CI fails on any dataset or result record referencing a source not marked approved in sources/allowlist.yml.
CI fails on any dataset or result record missing a required provenance field (as defined in pathology-image-benchmarks-prov-001).
CI linter asserts every model card and dataset artifact carries the 'not for clinical or diagnostic use; research only' notice.
Python WSI tooling is isolated as an adapter (e.g. adapters/wsi-python/) with a placeholder or stub; it is not placed in the agent-neutral core (packages/).
pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass on the scaffold with no real data.
The repo structure follows Hee-Lee Oss conventions: TypeScript/ESM, pnpm workspaces, no secrets or tokens committed.
output: A monorepo scaffold PR with pnpm workspaces, TypeScript/ESM core packages, a Python adapter placeholder, and three passing CI linters (license-gate, provenance-completeness, not-for-clinical-use).
